thread:
sophia-cs: FYI Acme reported their ingest validators started failing immediately after today's rollout (09:12 UTC). They say numeric fields are coming back quoted and some nested objects collapsed. Errors: "expected number, got string", "duplicate key 'orderId_v2'"
li-eng: Can you paste the raw model output they showed?
sophia-cs: Pasted below from customer (anonymized). They said this was fine yesterday.
---
Customer-expected:
```json
{"orderId": 12345, "items": [{"sku": "A1", "qty": 2}], "total_cents": 2599}
```
Customer-actual (post-deploy):
```json
{"orderId": "12345", "items": [{"pair": ["sku","A1"], "pair": ["qty", "2"]}], "total_cents": "+2599", "orderId_v2": "12345"}
```
---
raj-support: Who rolled the model? Was this a config-only change or new model artifact?
emily-pm: Deploy bot shows a model variant switch in the pipeline at 09:11:58 UTC. @deploy-bot can you paste details?
deploy-bot: Deploy recorded: id=deploy-20260317-091158 model=redwood/opt-3b:2026-03-17-09 variant=serial-fix-batch rollout=100% by=li-eng
matt-oncall: :eyes: 100% rollout at 09:11 — that matches timing. li, was there any post-processing step added that might stringify numeric tokens?
li-eng: We changed tokenizer postproc to prefer safe-serial format for some edgecases (ticket #INF-402) — it may wrap bare numbers to preserve sign. I did not expect it to change nested structure. Investigating asap.
sophia-cs: Customer reports their JSON schema validator fails in our partner ingestion (strict number types). They're blocking production traffic. Any chance to rollback the variant?
matt-oncall: I can pin traffic back to previous model variant (redwood/opt-3b:2026-03-10-stable) for Acme and apply a hotfix. Need request IDs from their failing calls to confirm.
raj-support: Asked customer for one failing request-id and sample request body. Also asked if they can reproduce against the hosted playground with same prompt.
sophia-cs: Customer sent a sample request-id: req_0a9f3c. They gave the request body and prompt; they said reproduces every time.
li-eng: Debug plan: 1) fetch req_0a9f3c logs and output blob 2) run model locally with same prompt + deterministic seed 3) compare pre-deploy vs post-deploy tokens 4) if root cause in postproc, rollback and release patch.
emily-pm: Prioritize this high — Acme is on a reserved plan. Keep me posted.
sophia-cs: Customer is ok with a short rollback window if we can confirm fix.
matt-oncall: Rolling back routing for Acme now to stable variant. I will update when complete.
---
(approx 10m later)
matt-oncall: Rolled back Acme to redwood/opt-3b:2026-03-10-stable at 09:22 UTC. Please verify with customer.
sophia-cs: Customer confirms validator passes on rollback. :white_check_mark: They will monitor for a few minutes and report if anything else appears.
li-eng: Reproduced locally — bug introduced by postproc: when a sequence looked like a mini-dict it was emitted as array-of-pairs and numbers prepended with "+" to avoid negative-range ambiguity. Fix incoming.
li-eng: Patch ready, will create canary with conservative postproc, then run strict JSON tests against our schema suite.
emily-pm: Thanks. Make sure to add a non-regression test for strict numeric typing and nested object fidelity.
sophia-cs: Customer notified and will await the safe canary. Closing loop once canary passes QA and customer signs off. :thumbsup:
